tags: winger/attacking midfielder, joined Union Berlin academy from Energie Cottbus in summer 2025
made Bundesliga debut 11 April 2026 (16y 3d), second-youngest player in Bundesliga history after Youssoufa Moukoko
regarded internally at Union as Germany's top talent from the 2010 age group; compared to Jamal Musiala for footballing intelligence and dribbling

off_pitch.notes: Reported to have turned down interest from other clubs (including reportedly Bayern Munich, per a Goal.com list of teenage prospects) to join Union Berlin's first-team pathway.
